FlexScriptClass.name: Particles
FlexScriptClass.Summary: The Particles module namespace. Provides the global accessor to the one Particles.System per model.

Description.code: Particles.System sys = Particles.system; Particles.Emitter e = Model.find("ParticleEmitter1");

Property.name: system
Property.Summary: The model's single Particles.System (NULL if no emitter has been created yet).
